acquirer: Inflexion Private Equity Partners LLP (via Inflexion Buyout Fund V)

deal_value.notes: Voluntary cash offer initially NOK 34.40/share = NOK 1.49bn (~US$170.7M per Reuters), recommended by the board in Dec 2020; raised to NOK 40/share (~NOK 1.73bn) on Mar 1, 2021, implying ~US$199M at ~8.7 NOK/USD (approximate conversion). Completed and delisted June 2021. Values are equity value, not EV.

calculable.implied_multiple: ~1.4x equity value / annualized revenue (run-rate; not EV)
calculable.calculation: Equity value NOK ~1.73bn ~= US$199M ~= EUR ~166M (approx. 10.4 NOK/EUR). Annualized revenue = 4 x Q1 2021 group revenue of EUR 30.2M = EUR 120.8M; 166 / 120.8 = ~1.4x. On EBITDA: 4 x Q1 2021 EBITDA EUR 5.7M = EUR 22.8M -> ~7.3x equity value/run-rate EBITDA (excludes net debt).
inputs: Final offer NOK 40/share, total ~NOK 1.7bn - MarketScreener deal record: https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/INFRONT-ASA-37941051/news/Inflexion-Buyout-V-Investments-LP-completed-the-acquisition-of-Infront-ASA-OB-INFRO-from-Kristian-33465633/

Initial offer NOK 34.40/share = NOK 1.49bn = US$170.7M, 30.9%/56.0% premium to 1M/3M VWAP to Dec 14, 2020 - Reuters via PE Insights: https://pe-insights.com/inflexion-to-buy-norways-infront-in-171-mln-deal/

Q1 2021 group revenue EUR 30.2M and EBITDA EUR 5.7M - Infront ASA Q1 2021 release via MFN: https://mfn.se/ob/a/infront/infront-asa-q1-2021-group-revenue-of-eur-30-2-million-and-ebitda-of-eur-5-7-million-55b15934.iframe

Q4 2020 operating revenue EUR 29.7M, reported EBITDA EUR 5.7M (adjusted EUR 6.2M) - Infront Q4 2020 interim report: https://www.infront.co/content/dam/infront-co/language-masters/en/downloads/quarterly-reports/infront-q4-2020-interim-report.pdf.coredownload.pdf
calculable.caveats: FY2020 full-year revenue/EBITDA totals were not directly verified within the search budget (only Q4 2020 and Q1 2021 quarterly figures sourced; annualization is approximate). Net debt at offer date not sourced, so a true EV/Revenue or EV/EBITDA multiple cannot be computed (Infront carried debt from the 2019 vwd Group acquisition). NOK/USD and NOK/EUR conversions approximate.
